title: City Council District 5
statement: This week I'm doing what I promised in my own district and around it: the Fruitvale briefing record for the Alternative Response Initiative gets executed and published so D3 families can see their own calls answered, and East Oakland's record gets filed alongside it — no more waiting on a document nobody can open. I'm also answering Director Vance straight on the apprenticeship placement-gap analysis: the data is the city's to publish, and I'm naming where D5's contribution stands rather than letting a stalled pipeline read as a closed door. Our streets are holding steady and our storefronts are up, and I intend to keep it that way by earning every bit of it in the open.

payload.text: Director Vance — the placement-gap analysis is a city workforce publication, not a district handout, and I won't pretend D5's office owns the publishing stamp. What I own is D5's side: East Oakland young people's intake and placement figures, gathered with the neighborhood organizations already doing the work, and I will deliver that contribution in a form the publishing office can actually use. So identify the office of record for the pipeline's placement-gap analysis and the format it needs, and I will file East Oakland's contribution against it this cycle — with the community organizations' names attached, not just a spreadsheet. If the publishing office can't be named, say so plainly, and I'll bring the gap into a public briefing myself rather than let silence stand in for a document.

numberMoved: INIT-002 advanced one work move (briefing record execution and publication); D5 contribution scoped for the apprenticeship placement-gap analysis via CONF-116 answer.
